
VALIDATE-FOUNDATION-SCHEMA
Validate foundation.json against its JSON schema using Ajv

USAGE
  fspec validate-foundation-schema

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Validate foundation.json structure
  $ fspec validate-foundation-schema
  ✓ foundation.json is valid
✓ All required fields present
✓ All diagrams have valid structure

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-foundation-schema
  fspec show-foundation
  fspec update-foundation

NOTES
  • Uses Ajv for JSON Schema validation
  • Checks required fields, types, and structure
  • Run after any manual edits to foundation.json
